cases.input: My car won't start on the M25 hard shoulder and I have AA breakdown cover. What should I do?
cases.actual_output:
Sorry to hear that! Don't worry, we're here to help. As you're on the M25 hard shoulder, it's essential to prioritize your safety. Here's what you should do:

1. Move your vehicle to a safe location: If possible, carefully move your car to the nearest emergency lane or a safe distance from the traffic flow. This will help prevent any potential hazards or accidents.
2. Call the AA: Reach for your phone and dial our emergency number: 03330 046 046. Our team will be with you in no time to assist with your breakdown.

As you have AA breakdown cover, you're eligible for our Roadside Assistance service. Our trained operators will guide you through the process and dispatch a technician to your location.

Remember to stay calm, and we'll take care of the rest. We'll get you back on the road in no time!
cases.expected_output: First get to safety: pull as far to the left as you can with your wheels turned to the left, switch on your hazard lights, and get everyone out through the left-hand doors. Stand behind the barrier on the verge, away from traffic, and put on a high-vis jacket if you have one. Don't attempt any repair on a motorway. Then report the breakdown by calling the AA on 03330 046 046 (on a motorway use the phone, not the app). Look for a driver location sign or marker post to give your position. An AA patrol will come to try to fix the car at the roadside, and if it can't be fixed there you may be recovered depending on your cover.

cases.input: I've got a flat tyre and no spare. Will an AA patrol fix it and will I have to pay for a new tyre?
cases.actual_output:
Sorry to hear that you've got a flat tyre! Don't worry, we're here to help. As an AA member, you're entitled to our Roadside Assistance service, which includes tyre changing. If you have a flat tyre and no spare, our patrol will do their best to change it for you.

If the tyre is damaged beyond repair, we'll need to replace it. In this case, you'll need to pay for a new tyre, but don't worry, we'll guide you through the process. Our patrol will assess the situation and provide a quote for the new tyre. If you're happy with the quote, we'll arrange for the new tyre to be fitted.

Remember, as an AA member, you're covered for Roadside Assistance, which includes tyre changing, as part of your membership package. Just give us a call on 03330 046 046, and we'll send a patrol to help you get back on the road.
cases.expected_output: An AA patrol will come out and try to get you mobile, for example with a tyre sealant or by recovering the car to a nearby garage if it can't be made safe at the roadside. Patrols don't carry replacement tyres, so the cost of a new tyre or garage repair isn't part of standard cover. If you have added Tyre Cover, the AA can help towards eligible repair or replacement costs up to £160 per tyre, subject to that cover's terms.
